title: How tumours grow
goal: Watch how a cluster of cells grows when every cell keeps doubling.
intro: A tumour is a lump of cells. Cancer cells keep dividing, and each one splits into two. Watch the cluster under the scanner. How will its size change?

prediction.question: If you watch the tumour for a long time, how does its size change?
options: It grows by the same amount every month
It grows fast at first, then slows down
It stays tiny for a long time, then grows fast
It grows in bursts with long pauses

cases.answer: It stays tiny for a long time, then grows fast
It grows fast at first, then slows down

answer.otherwise: It grows by the same amount every month

tryAtHome.title: Doubling you can hold
steps: Fold it in half and count the layers: 2.
Keep folding until you can't fold any more.
tryAtHome.watch: The first folds hardly add anything. The last ones add a lot. That's doubling.
tryAtHome.safety: Safe to do anywhere. Mind the sharp paper edges.
